title: PV material recovery research status
claim: AGASTYA is a research concept for automated silver extraction from end-of-life PV modules.
source: AGASTYA thesis and project owner correction recorded in AGASTYA_ARCHITECTURE.md
limitation: No AGASTYA physical silver-removal trial, assay or recovery is recorded; cover image is illustrative.

title: A panel is a mixed material system
claim: PV modules contain bonded, mixed material layers and cell metallization.
source: Mulazzani et al. (2022), DOI 10.3390/en15228419; cited illustrative image attribution
limitation: Actual module construction and Ag inventory vary by technology, age and source; no AGASTYA panel assay.

title: One project, four connected workstreams
claim: Digital inspection, process research, separation evaluation and measurement are connected workstreams.
source: AGASTYA project index, architecture, EYE README and data guide
limitation: The proposed physical stages are unvalidated; EYE does not perform separation.

title: What can a material balance prove?
claim: Mass accounting can describe measured yields and silver balances when feed and output streams are traced.
source: AGASTYA Phase B/C accounting model and data guide
limitation: Method proposal only; no physical stream or assay data.

title: Four stages, one evidence chain
claim: Current process map: inspection/routing; manual mechanical preparation; thermal treatment/delamination; silver removal/recovery.
source: Project owner correction recorded 16 October 2026; AGASTYA_ARCHITECTURE.md
limitation: Stage 4 method, feed preparation and product form remain open; no stage performance is validated.

title: An inspection and record tool—not a silver detector
claim: AGASTYA-EYE records inspection evidence and human-reviewed routing; it does not detect silver.
source: Agastya-EYE README and Stage 1 app documentation
limitation: No validated silver detection or physical sorting claim.

title: Thermal delamination is the Stage 3 reference
claim: A guarded hot-knife is a literature reference for Stage 3 glass/laminate delamination.
source: IEA PVPS Task 12-25:2023 full report; NPC manufacturer product page checked 20 October 2026
limitation: IEA study is a pilot-plant inventory with fair data quality and downstream metal recovery outside scope. NPC timings and 300 C are vendor claims. Neither source validates Agastya performance or operating conditions.

title: What the historical 200,080 rows actually contain
claim: Historical virtual outputs total 200,080 rows across distinct scenario, thermal, feed-preparation and conditional arithmetic records.
source: PROCEDURES_AND_RESULTS.md, data_dictionary.csv, saved model outputs and Phase E simulation records
limitation: Rows are calculations/time histories, not independent experiments, measured PSD, assays or process trials.

title: Silver can partition into fine fractions
claim: Published studies report study-specific silver partition into fine fractions.
source: Sim et al. (2022), DOI 10.1016/j.wasman.2022.11.023; Juyo Salazar et al. (2024), DOI 10.1016/j.susmat.2024.e01047
limitation: Study feeds and denominators differ; the reported fractions do not define Agastya product grade or recovery.

title: Electrostatic evidence is incomplete for silver
claim: An electrostatic PV study reports Ag/Al/Si co-concentration, but accessible evidence lacks a complete Ag mass balance.
source: de Souza & Veit (2023), DOI 10.1016/j.cec.2023.100027; published comparator cited in the deck
limitation: Unselected Stage 4 comparator only; not current Stage 3 and not an Agastya recovery result.

title: A strong result on a different feed
claim: Published flotation results demonstrate study-specific assay-based reporting on prepared PV-cell feed.
source: Saffarian, Galvin & Firouzi (2026), DOI 10.1016/j.mineng.2026.110189
limitation: Different prepared and ground feed, reagents and study conditions; not an Agastya prediction or student procedure.

title: Four different quantities answer four questions
claim: Mass yield, Ag grade, Ag recovery and balance residual answer distinct accounting questions.
source: AGASTYA Phase B/C accounting definitions
limitation: No Agastya mass measurements or assay exist.

title: Reference values have different limits
claim: Published Ag reference values retain separate source bases and unresolved provenance differences.
source: Mulazzani et al. (2022), DOI 10.3390/en15228419; Dias et al. (2016), DOI 10.1016/j.wasman.2016.03.016; evidence register
limitation: 300 ppm source basis unresolved; 600 g/t and secondary 630 g/t are not combined or treated as an Agastya assay.

title: The tools match the evidence we have
claim: The project executed EYE software checks, accounting self-checks and numerical thermal-model studies.
source: Local project source, runtime inventory and saved procedure records
limitation: Software and numerical checks do not establish physical accuracy, process safety or recovery.

title: What is done — and what is not
claim: Project records distinguish completed desk work and code checks from missing samples, assays and process validation.
source: PROJECT_STATUS.md and source/evidence registers
limitation: Counts refer to documented records/checks, not process performance.

title: Close the evidence gaps in order
claim: Next gates are interface definition, traceable sample/qualified host, reviewed thermal Stage 3 plan and supervised trial.
source: OPEN_QUESTIONS.md, MASTER_TASK_LIST.md and Stage 3 package
limitation: Plan only; host, sample and approval remain unresolved.

title: Environmental benefit must be measured
claim: Environmental benefit requires measured process inputs, outputs, transport and waste boundary.
source: IEA PVPS Task 12-25:2023; AGASTYA sustainability boundary and reviewed PV recycling literature
limitation: No Agastya environmental or economic result is measured.

title: Primary references used in this deck
claim: Sources are attributed to their own feed and methods.
source: Slide citations and linked primary/official references; full record in evidence register
limitation: Transfer limits and access level are stated in notes/register; some sources are abstract-level.

title: Build the evidence chain first
claim: The defensible next claim depends on a measured stream, qualified assay and closed, honest balance.
source: AGASTYA architecture, accounting definitions, evidence register and open questions
limitation: Research framework only; no recovery result.
